daily.today_energy: Mercury's got your back today, Virgo. You're in that sweet spot where your intuition and logic are actually vibing together. Trust the synchronicities—they're breadcrumbs, not coincidences.

daily.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not punishment. A walk, stretching, dancing in your room—whatever makes you feel alive. Mental clarity follows when you stop forcing it.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to soften your grip on control. Mercury's vibe suggests that messy growth beats perfect stagnation. Trust the detours—they're teaching you something your checklist couldn't.
